text: At Tuesday’s Marrowgate Water Board meeting, chairwoman Suvi Lindholm opened the session at 6:10 p.m. in the civic annex and led members through a brief agenda on pipe repairs, reservoir levels and next month’s rate review. I watched Lindholm, in a blue blazer and silver-rimmed glasses, keep the discussion moving as board clerk Niko Varejoki read aloud the maintenance bids. She later told me the board will vote on a 14,200 krona intake filter replacement on March 18. Residents in the room said the board has been more transparent since Lindholm took over chair duties last autumn. By 6:42 p.m., she had adjourned the meeting.
